# agentic-sdd

> Spec-Driven Development that finishes: one skill that drives GitHub Spec Kit end to end on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Grok Build, runs pstack inside every phase, and closes a feature only on REA runtime evidence. One converge per spec; small specs; seven harness layers probed per host.

Read SKILL.md first, then references/INDEX.md for which reference the current step needs. Paths are relative to the repository root; the links below point at the raw files on the main branch.

To install on the machine you are running on: run `npx agentic-sdd --dry-run` (node 20+, python3, git), show the user the detected state and the full plan including manual items, ask once, and only on yes run `npx agentic-sdd --yes`. Then report the verify output, what must be restarted, and what must be done inside an IDE. Change nothing the plan did not list. The README's "Agent mode" section holds the same procedure as a paste-ready prompt.

## Start here

- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/README.md): Install (one-shot), per-host setup, keeping dependencies current, uninstall, evidence, license
- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/SKILL.md): The skill entrypoint: Final Goal driver, phase contracts, universal first actions, hard boundaries
- [references/INDEX.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/references/INDEX.md): Load map: which reference to open at which step

## Core references

- [references/phase-card.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/references/phase-card.md): Every feature: required phase→obligation rows, breadcrumb lines, common REA path; points to the long references
- [references/spec-kit-alignment.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/references/spec-kit-alignment.md): Project/feature resolution, Spec Kit commands, non-SDD entry
- [references/phase-contract.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/references/phase-contract.md): Entering or handing off a phase
- [references/harness-layers.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/references/harness-layers.md): Seven harness layers × Spec Kit × pstack × host; readiness via `scripts/harness_probe.py`
- [references/pstack-integration.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/references/pstack-integration.md): Phase→pstack map, per-host leaf dispatch (Cursor / Claude / Codex / Grok), hook precedence, review gate, full-autonomy grant
- [references/single-loop-default.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/references/single-loop-default.md): Before spawning any subagent: the three triggers, return schema, folding leaves back, breadcrumbs
- [references/poteto-mode-anatomy.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/references/poteto-mode-anatomy.md): How each host reaches pstack poteto-mode (mandate, user-only on Cursor), what the skill does when it runs, port vs Cursor plugin differences
- [references/model-routing.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/references/model-routing.md): Child model/effort from pstack sheet → defaults → parent; per-host dispatch
- [references/rea-closeout.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/references/rea-closeout.md): Mandatory post-converge REA analysis; install if missing
- [references/recovery.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/references/recovery.md): Repeated failure, conflicting diagnoses, scope drift
- [references/direction-keeper.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/references/direction-keeper.md): Before next feature / acceptance review
- [references/verification-execution.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/references/verification-execution.md): Running approved CLI checks / evidence
- [references/host-guide-greenfield-brownfield.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/references/host-guide-greenfield-brownfield.md): Human+agent guide: greenfield vs brownfield on Claude / Codex / Cursor
- [references/starting-tool-considerations.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/references/starting-tool-considerations.md): Claude / Codex / Cursor / Grok bootstrap
- [references/agent-compatibility.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/references/agent-compatibility.md): Host matrix, missing tools, Grok file-based mode
- [references/cursor-continuation.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/references/cursor-continuation.md): Cursor only: `progress.md` machine line and stop-hook resume

## Templates and scripts

- [templates/playbooks/agentic-sdd.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/templates/playbooks/agentic-sdd.md): pstack project playbook: three Spec Kit handoffs anchored on Feature and Bug fix steps (pstack-claude port)
- [templates/cursor-rules/agentic-sdd.mdc](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/templates/cursor-rules/agentic-sdd.mdc): Cursor project rule carrying the same handoffs; Cursor's plugin cannot invoke poteto-mode itself
- [scripts/progress_gate.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/scripts/progress_gate.py): Completion gate over progress.md: review line, rea pass line per feature, misformatted breadcrumbs
- [scripts/harness_probe.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/scripts/harness_probe.py): Readiness probe for the seven harness layers per host; prints the progress.md breadcrumbs
- [scripts/setup.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/scripts/setup.py): One-shot setup: detect, plan, confirm, apply, verify
- [scripts/deps.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/scripts/deps.py): Installed-vs-latest check and unattended update for Spec Kit, pstack per host, REA pins, host CLIs
- [install.sh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/install.sh): Installer and exact-inverse uninstaller

## Evidence

- [docs/BENCHMARKS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/docs/BENCHMARKS.md): Method, routing table, gate-by-gate matrix of what each host invoked at every Spec Kit gate, result comparisons, A/B against plain Spec Kit
- [docs/evals/2026-10-24-single-loop-ab/result.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/docs/evals/2026-10-24-single-loop-ab/result.md): Isolated A/B of 1.1.6 vs 1.2.0 single-loop rule (no measurable gain) and the 1.2.1 fixes for parked reviewers and uncounted breadcrumbs
- [docs/evals/2026-10-20-host-matrix/result.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/docs/evals/2026-10-20-host-matrix/result.md): Four hosts × routing prompts, a real feature, and a three-part goal; black-box, converge count, REA ids, cost
- [docs/evals/2026-10-20-host-matrix/prediction.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/docs/evals/2026-10-20-host-matrix/prediction.md): Pre-registered predictions for that matrix
- [docs/evals/2026-10-19-sandbox-ab/result.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jonsoku-dev/agentic-sdd/main/docs/evals/2026-10-19-sandbox-ab/result.md): Spec Kit alone versus this stack on one brief
